import bpy
ns=bpy.app.driver_namespace['terminal_craft']
exec(r'''
# Weathering belongs to the mineral face, exposed lips and sheltered overlap.
S=2048;P=512
roofmaps={k:np.ones((S,S,4),np.float32) for k in ['albedo','normal','roughness']}
for variant in range(16):
 yy,xx=np.mgrid[0:P,0:P];u=xx/(P-1);v=yy/(P-1)
 mass=band(1700+variant,4,P,.6);mineral=band(1800+variant,28,P,.65);grain=band(1900+variant,110,P)
 # A worn lip and short split laminae, with broad undisturbed mineral areas.
 lip=np.exp(-(1-v)/.045)*(.5+.22*mineral)
 head=np.exp(-v/.11)*(.5+.15*mass)
 trace=.73+.025*np.sin(u*12+variant)+.008*np.sin(u*29+variant*2)
 cleave=np.exp(-((v-trace)/.007)**2)*np.clip(np.sin(u*8+variant)*2,0,1)
 film=np.clip((mass-.6)*.18,0,.28)*(1-v)*.55
 shift=[-7,-2,3,7][variant%4]
 base=np.array([84,82,73])+shift
 tone=mass*2.8+mineral*.9+grain*.25+lip*9-head*4-cleave*4
 rgb=base+tone[:,:,None]+film[:,:,None]*np.array([-8,-5,-9])
 # Directional slate cleave, not uniform all-over embossed noise.
 h=.000045*grain+.00011*mineral+.00012*mass-.00065*cleave-.00022*lip
 gy,gx=np.gradient(h);nm=np.stack([-gx*(P-1)/.55,-gy*(P-1)/.72,np.ones_like(h)],-1);nm/=np.linalg.norm(nm,axis=-1,keepdims=True)
 rough=np.clip(.59+.055*mass+.022*mineral+.14*lip+.06*film-.04*head,.41,.86)
 x=variant%4*P;y=variant//4*P
 roofmaps['albedo'][y:y+P,x:x+P,:3]=np.clip(rgb/255,0,1)
 roofmaps['normal'][y:y+P,x:x+P,:3]=nm*.5+.5
 roofmaps['roughness'][y:y+P,x:x+P,:3]=rough[:,:,None]
slate=bpy.data.materials['HarborCraft_Terminal_Slate']
for suffix,arr in roofmaps.items():
 path=out/('HarborCraft_SeaWornSlate_'+suffix+'.png');png(path,arr)
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if suffix=='albedo' else 'Non-Color';im.pack()
 for node in slate.node_tree.nodes:
  if node.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and node.image and suffix in node.image.name:node.image=im
for node in slate.node_tree.nodes:
 if node.type=='NORMAL_MAP':node.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.72
slate.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF').inputs['Specular IOR Level'].default_value=.36
changed=0
for ob in c.objects:
 if ob.type!='MESH' or not ob.data.materials or ob.data.materials[0]!=slate:continue
 if ' slate ' not in ob.name and 'Gallery slate' not in ob.name:continue
 seed=sum((i+1)*ord(ch) for i,ch in enumerate(ob.name));rng=np.random.default_rng(seed+923)
 if ob.get('sea_worn_lip'):continue
 if len(ob.data.vertices) not in [4,8]:continue
 p=[v.co.copy() for v in ob.data.vertices[:4]]
 if 'Gallery slate' in ob.name:
  # Gallery's high edge is the original rear pair.
  p=[p[3],p[2],p[1],p[0]]
 cut=.02 if seed%7==0 else .006
 perimeter=[(0,0),(0,1),(.84,1),(1,1-cut),(1,.74),(1-(.045 if seed%4==0 else .005),.68),(1,.60),(1,.27),(1-(.025 if seed%9==0 else 0),.22),(1,.16),(1,cut),(.91,0)]
 thickness=.029+(seed%5)*.0016
 verts=[]
 def point(a,b):
  pt=p[0].lerp(p[1],b).lerp(p[3].lerp(p[2],b),a)
  # The ridge is seated; only the unsupported lower edge has slight cupping.
  pt.z+=a*(.003*(seed%5-2)+.004*math.sin(b*math.pi))
  pt.y+=a*.0025*math.sin(seed)
  return pt
 for a,b in perimeter:verts.append(tuple(point(a,b)))
 n=len(verts);verts += [(x,y,z-thickness) for x,y,z in verts]
 faces=[tuple(range(n)),tuple(reversed(range(n,n*2)))]
 faces += [(i,(i+1)%n,(i+1)%n+n,i+n) for i in range(n)]
 old=ob.data;me=bpy.data.meshes.new(ob.name+' sea-cleaved');me.from_pydata(verts,[],faces);me.materials.append(slate);me.update();ob.data=me
 for mod in list(ob.modifiers):ob.modifiers.remove(mod)
 mod=ob.modifiers.new('Worn mineral edge','BEVEL');mod.width=.0014;mod.segments=1
 uv=me.uv_layers.new(name='HarborSurfaceUV');variant=(seed*7+seed//13)%16;px=variant%4*P;py=variant//4*P
 width=(p[1]-p[0]).length;length=((p[3]+p[2]-p[0]-p[1])*.5).length
 for poly in me.polygons:
  for li in poly.loop_indices:
   vi=me.loops[li].vertex_index%n;a,b=perimeter[vi]
   uu=.03+b*min(.94,width/.55*.94);vv=.97-(1-a)*min(.94,length/.72*.94)
   uv.data[li].uv=((px+uu*P)/S,(py+vv*P)/S)
 ob['sea_worn_lip']=True;changed+=1
print('SEA_WORN_ROOF',changed)
# Record pivots before restructuring exports.
for o in c.objects:
 if any(s in o.name.lower() for s in ['drum','pulley','wheel','flange','winch axle','winch crank']):print('ROTATING_CANDIDATE',o.name)
''',ns)
